Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities, assays. Join: compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno; molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno; activities to assays on assay_id. Filter: assays.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1054504'; activities.standard_value is not null; activities.standard_relation equals '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ascending, chembl_id ascending, standard_type ascending, standard_relation ascending, standard_value ascending, standard_units ascending.
